parsed.rationale: QS complexes in V1–V4 with convex ST elevation (about 2 mm or more in V2–V3) and no reciprocal pattern from a bundle branch block point to anterior MI. The noisy limb leads and low T/QRS ratio mean an old MI with an LV aneurysm can't be excluded, so check this against symptoms, troponin and any earlier ECG.
